## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome boy with broad shoulders, curly brown hair, and roguish hazel eyes. He possesses a frank face with clear, straightforward eyes, and a mouth often twisted into a teasing smile. At one point, he appears noticeably pale and thin.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 ch.Lady P58](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0058), [v3 ch.Weddings P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever, determined, and ambitious individual with a notable streak of stubbornness. Known for his good-natured personality, sense of humor, and teasing manner, he is widely popular wherever he goes. Driven by a zest for life, he harbors a strong motivation to get the best out of life while contributing honest, real work to the world, specifically aiming to become a doctor to fight disease, pain, and ignorance. His academic and personal pursuits include striving to be first in his class, working toward High Honors and the Cooper Prize, and quietly seeking to purchase the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place.

## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after three years in Alberta, quickly rekindling an intense academic rivalry with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after she smashed a slate over his head for teasing her. Despite her lingering silence, Gilbert secretly harbored feelings for her, saved her from drowning on the pond, and eventually tied with her for first place on the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. They both attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Gilbert earned the class medal while [Anne](../character/anne.md) won a scholarship. Upon returning home, Gilbert surrendered his secured teaching position in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) so [Anne](../character/anne.md) could stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) Cuthbert's death, leading to their reconciliation as friends. While teaching locally, Gilbert helped form the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md) before they both departed to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). At [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), he excelled academically, winning High Honors in Classics and the Cooper Prize, while also captaining the Freshman football team and serving as class president. During their second year, Gilbert proposed to [Anne](../character/anne.md) in an orchard, but she rejected him, insisting she only viewed him as a friend. Resigned to her decision, he stepped back and allowed rumors to circulate regarding a potential romance with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), which deeply bothered [Anne](../character/anne.md). After graduating, Gilbert contracted a severe case of typhoid fever back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), but his eventual recovery prompted a realization of Anne's true feelings. They walked together to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden, where Gilbert proposed a second time, and she happily accepted. Following their wedding in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard, Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne.md) moved to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), where he established his medical practice. Their early married life brought tragedy when their firstborn daughter, Joyce, died shortly after birth, though they later welcomed a healthy son named [James Matthew](../character/james-a.md).

## Quotes

> "Well, I must run up to MacPhersons’. Moody Spurgeon came home from Queen’s today for Sunday and he was to bring me out a book Professor Boyd is lending me."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P19](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0019)

> "You’re just tired, Anne. Come, forget it all and take a walk with me—a ramble back through the woods beyond the marsh. There should be something there I want to show you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P15](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0015)

> "No. I only know it should be, from something I saw there in spring. Come on. We’ll pretend we are two children again and we’ll go the way of the wind."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P17](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0017)

> "Here’s a fallen tree with a cushion of moss. Sit down, Anne—it will serve for a woodland throne. I’ll climb for some apples. They all grow high—the tree had to reach up to the sunlight."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P34](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0034)

> "I persist in dreaming it, although it has often seemed to me that it could never come true. I dream of a home with a hearth-fire in it, a cat and dog, the footsteps of friends—and you!"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Time P22](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0022)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and Anne's relationship began with a bitter schoolyard rivalry after Gilbert famously pulled her hair and called her 'Carrots,' leading her to smash a slate over his head and refuse his apologies for years. Over time, their fierce academic competition turned into a deep camaraderie as they prepared for higher education together and later co-organized the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). Their connection eventually blossomed into a devoted romance, culminating in their marriage and shared home at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert first encountered [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a fierce academic rival competing with him to be at the top of their class. Despite his early attempts to apologize for teasing her, she held a long-standing grudge and treated him with cold contempt, even after he rescued her from a sinking dory. They eventually put their animosity behind them to work as comrades in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and pursue their studies side by side.
